MORE:
Mudunuru Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. Un-audited Financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
2. Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
3. To consider and evaluate a proposal for raising funds through the issuance of one or more instruments, including equity shares, warrants convertible into equity shares, or other securities, by way of preferential issue, private placement or any other permissible mode(s), in accordance with the applicable provisions of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018, and other applicable laws.
4. To consider convening a General Meeting of the members of the Company to seek their approval for the aforementioned fund-raising proposal. 
5. Any other business with the permission of the Chair.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On Thursday, 12Th November, 2026.
